name: @la/contract
description: The drop-in language-pack contract, v0: the nine port types (text-in/tokens-out verify, token spine with spanGroup, annotation + LearningEvent envelopes, per-(dim × unit) ScaffoldDirective, mastery-graph declarations incl. creditLeakEdges), the pack-manifest zod schema, and deriveCapabilities — plus the HAND-AUTHORED sidecar OpenAPI document (sidecar/openapi.yaml, ADR §3.2) and its generated typed client at the ./sidecar-client subpath (openapi-typescript + openapi-fetch; regenerate via `pnpm run generate:sidecar-client`, freshness-gated in CI). ZERO workspace dependencies (ADR §2.4 rule c); zod and openapi-fetch are the only external runtime deps (openapi-fetch loads only through the subpath).
